name: Samira Haddad
about_me: I'm Samira, a transportation planner with the City of Ann Arbor. I run pieces of the Main Street curb-management pilot. I need startups or researchers with sensor data on delivery-vehicle parking.
goals: Find a sensor-data partner for the curb-management pilot

debriefs.text: Hannah Brooks, my colleague in city planning, leads the curb pilot and wants data by March. She said Routewise might have delivery-stop data.

Met Ben Hartley at the Detroit mobility summit. He's an engineering manager at Routewise, which routes delivery fleets. He said their stop data is proprietary but could be shared under a pilot agreement.
Irene Kovacs from Detroit's Office of Mobility Innovation ran a similar pilot last year and offered to share their data-sharing template. I promised to send her our pilot scope.
Talked to Luis Romero, operations manager at Lakeside Cold Storage in Detroit. His drivers complain about Main Street loading zones and he'd love a routing pilot.
Omar Haddad is not related to me, people keep asking. He's the GridLeaf founder and wants curbside battery storage for food trucks.

card.headline: Transportation planner, City of Ann Arbor
card.about: Curb management and delivery loading zones.
